metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Spring Boot 3.0 build tool migration (Gradle/Maven configuration updates). It differs semantically from peer candidates (Security, Batch, Session configuration migrations) and from existing skills (JavaScript bundle analysis, Flink DataStream testing). No existing skill covers build tool version and dependency management migration for Spring Boot 3.0. Peer candidates represent sibling migration workflows in the same method_family but target different subsystems (security, batch, session). This skill should be created as a new capability.
